correctness.rationale: Lemma 1 reconstructs all rank-two sentences from realized five-position-class first-order rank-one pointed profiles, and also supplies distinguishing rank-two sentences for absent profiles. Lemma 2 gives a case-by-case, exact append transfer depending only on the profile set, allowing induction over every binary word. The entire reachable-state closure has 32541 states and 32530 mixed ones; breadth-first minimal witness depth tops out at 24 with 16 classes there. The standalone packed-transition computation was run with assertions recomputing profiles from every shortest witness and every outgoing edge. An independent pair-enumeration implementation reproduced all counts and the complete depth histogram. The SHA-256 whole-state certificate and scripts are embedded. No finite-prefix-only inference is used.

The natural exact numerical rank-two index and shortest-model cutoff are additional computed structural invariants. There remains a priority risk that a derivation from the general theorem was previously written elsewhere.

value.rationale: The cardinality of the quotient by fixed-quantifier-depth equivalence and the least universal small-representative length are canonical invariants for the foundational logical language on words. The exact 32530 classes and sharp length 24 address a complete natural finite-index problem, rather than an arbitrary bounded-size sample; they can support exhaustive definability and finite-model tests for the successor-enriched rank-two fragment. The finite computation is structurally motivated and all-length complete through a proved deterministic append transfer.
